    Which are the best open-source snake-game projects? This list will help you: snk, snake, snake, snake-asm, snake-game, sssnake, and snake-c-wasm.

  • ⭐2166 yujqiao/DungeonRush: 👾🐍 A opensource game inspired by Snake, written in pure C with SDL
  • godot (gaming): Your open-source game engine
  • gdevelop (gaming): Free and easy game maker

Use these as inspiration for designing the app architecture.
